run_llm_swarm_script: run the llm swarm script to generate synthetic text completions from a prompts dataset using async inference
run_process_text: run the async process_text function to generate a completion for a single prompt sample with retry logic
run_main_generation_loop: run the main async loop to process dataset chunks, save checkpoints, and push results to HuggingFace Hub
review_Args_dataclass: review the Args dataclass that configures generation parameters, dataset options, and logging settings for the LLM swarm script
refactor_process_text_retries: refactor the process_text function to adjust the maximum retry count or retry delay for failed LLM requests
